title: Rav Ami bar Shmuel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Niddah 20b. In the same tractate, at 25b, he says, “It was explained to me by Mar Shmuel himself.” Hyman infers that he was Shmuel’s student.

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Niddah 20b fully writes Rav Ami bar Shmuel, supporting Rav for ר׳. The saved 28a paragraph instead attributes an explanation from Rav Huna to Rav Nachman and does not verify Hyman’s statement from Mar Shmuel or his discipleship inference. That citation and inference remain open; no whole-folio absence is asserted.

The quotation previously left open appears in Niddah 25b, where Rav Ami bar Shmuel says that Mar Shmuel explained the matter to him. Hyman’s print (vol. I, p. 227) gives 25a here, and the supplied Hebrew gives 28a. The similar wording at 28a concerns Rav Nachman and Rav Huna. The characterization of Ami as Shmuel’s student is Hyman’s inference.
